title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
summary: Primary method source: L2 penalty and weight decay differ under adaptive optimizers such as Adam; AdamW decouples the weight shrinkage. The paper reports improved generalization in its tested settings, which motivates but does not establish a benefit for this digits MLP.

title: torch.optim.AdamW
summary: Official API documentation for AdamW arguments and optimizer behavior; the fixture instantiates AdamW with a fixed learning rate and varies its weight_decay argument.

title: load_digits — scikit-learn documentation
summary: Official documentation states this bundled dataset has 1,797 8x8 handwritten digit images, 64 flattened features, ten classes, and integer pixel values 0–16. The fixture divides these known-scale pixels by 16.

title: train_test_split — scikit-learn documentation
summary: Official reference for reproducible random splitting and stratification; the fixture uses stratified splits with fixed seed 42.

title: How I Think About My Research Process: Explore, Understand, Distill
summary: Neel Nanda's research-process guide describes ideation, exploration, hypothesis testing, and distillation; emphasizes information gain, written highlights, skepticism, alternatives, and returning to exploration when evidence is anomalous. This cycle follows that process as a workflow heuristic.

title: How to avoid machine learning pitfalls: a guide for academic researchers
summary: Research guide covering reliable model building, evaluation, fair comparison, and reporting; informs the checks for leakage, matched comparisons, and narrow interpretation.

title: Troubling Trends in Machine Learning Scholarship
summary: Primary critique highlighting overclaiming, conflating explanation and speculation, and obscuring what causes empirical gains; informs explicit alternatives and restrained claims here.

title: NeurIPS Paper Checklist Guidelines
summary: Official reporting guidance asks authors to align claims with evidence, disclose limitations, and document reproducibility and assets. Used as a reporting reference, not as evidence that this study meets all venue standards.
